understanding: Wire the screen-behaviour catalogue (edge_cases_ui.json) and the screen-name map (screen_patterns.json) into the CLI: plan_feature new gains --screens and --roles (3 rows per role in section 7, protected by the audit), a read-only plan_feature cases prints the checklist, testplan new gives each open UI-family or role row a case, and baseline.KNOWN_KINDS includes the UI kinds; a project's <records root>/screen_patterns.json overlays the generic plugin map. Conventions read: AGENTS.md; analog followed: the edge_cases_infra.json merge in scripts/plan_feature.py and tests/test_edge_cases_infra.sh.
inputs_read: analog: scripts/plan_feature.py edge_cases_infra.json merge loop and tests/test_edge_cases_infra.sh
instructions: AGENTS.md (stdlib only, comments explain why, scoped diffs, tests assert detection and no false positives)
spec: specs/screen-patterns/spec.md sections 2b, 3, 10; contract.md as updated in b735380
naming: existing cmd_<verb> subcommands and *_PATH data constants in plan_feature.py

assumptions.text: Role names use the allowlist ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$, screen names must match a map entry exactly, project map files are validated before use, and table cells go through esc().
Diagnostics go to stderr so cases --json stdout stays valid JSON; failures exit 2.

decisions.decision: An empty --screens or --roles exits 2 rather than being ignored
decisions.basis: an explicit empty flag is almost always an empty shell variable

decisions.decision: A project screen map is checked against every contract rule
decisions.basis: a project checkout screen without payment would silently skip the risk floor

decisions.decision: 'risk raised' is printed only when --screens is used
decisions.basis: keeps output without the new flags byte-identical (spec E10)

one TC-E<n>-1 case per open UI-family or role section 7 row; --all-edge-cases
new suite covering AC-1..AC-7, AC-12 and the project-map overlay
